Parses the organization response, enforces exact-one cardinality, and returns the selected Moid.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

status = "ok"
statusCode = 200
message = "Organization resolved"
resultJson = "{}"
ready = False
organizationMoid = ""
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    rows = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        raise ValueError("Organization response does not contain a Results array.")
    expectedName = sys.argv[2].strip()
    if len(rows) != 1:
        status = "not-found" if len(rows) == 0 else "conflict"
        statusCode = 404 if len(rows) == 0 else 409
        message = "Organization lookup must return exactly one result; received %d." % len(rows)
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message, "resultCount": len(rows)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif rows[0].get("Name") != expectedName:
        status = "identity-mismatch"
        statusCode = 409
        message = "Organization response does not preserve the exact requested Name."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        organizationMoid = str(rows[0].get("Moid") or "")
        if not organizationMoid:
            raise ValueError("The exact organization result has no Moid.")
        resultJson = json.dumps({"organization": rows[0]}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status = "malformed"
    statusCode = 502
    message = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True

properties.script:
import json
import sys
status,statusCode,message,resultJson,ready="ok",200,"Rename source selected","{}",False
selectedMoid=selectedItemUrl="";selectedVersion=0
try:
 body=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);name=sys.argv[2];organizationMoid=sys.argv[3];rows=body.get("Results") if isinstance(body,dict) else None;count=body.get("Count") if isinstance(body,dict) else None
 if not isinstance(rows,list) or isinstance(count,bool) or not isinstance(count,int) or count<0: raise ValueError("Source family response must contain a non-negative integer Count and Results array.")
 if count>1000: status,statusCode,message="paging-required",422,"More than 1000 source family versions require internal paging; rename fails closed.";exact=[];preferred=[]
 elif count!=len(rows): status,statusCode,message="incomplete-page",422,"Source family Results are incomplete relative to Count; rename fails closed.";exact=[];preferred=[]
 else:
  exact=[row for row in rows if row.get("Name")==name and isinstance(row.get("Organization"),dict) and row["Organization"].get("Moid")==organizationMoid];preferred=[row for row in exact if row.get("PreferredVersion") is True]
 if status=="ok" and len(exact)!=len(rows): status,statusCode,message="identity-mismatch",409,"Source family response contains an identity outside the exact requested filter."
 elif status=="ok" and len(preferred)>1: status,statusCode,message="conflict",409,"Source family contains multiple preferred versions."
 elif status=="ok" and not exact: status,statusCode,message="not-found",404,"Source definition family was not found."
 elif status=="ok":
  chosen=preferred[0] if preferred else max(exact,key=lambda row:int(row.get("Version",0)));selectedMoid=str(chosen.get("Moid") or "");selectedVersion=int(chosen.get("Version",0))
  if not selectedMoid or selectedVersion<1: raise ValueError("Selected source identity is incomplete.")
  selectedItemUrl="/api/v1/workload/WorkloadDefinitions/"+selectedMoid;resultJson=json.dumps({"selected":chosen,"selection":"Preferred" if preferred else "Latest"},separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False)
 if status!="ok": resultJson=json.dumps({"error":message},separators=(",",":"))
 ready=True
except Exception as exc: status,statusCode,message,resultJson,ready="malformed",502,str(exc),json.dumps({"error":str(exc)},separators=(",",":")),True

Renames a complete Cisco Unified Edge workload definition family through workload.WorkloadMetadata.RenameRequest, never by PATCHing create-only WorkloadDefinition.Name. The workflow selects one preferred version or otherwise the latest, rejects target Name or generated RefName collisions across all versions, and optionally waits for RenameRequest Status UpdateScheduled/Updating to return to None plus exact resolution under the new name. The Generic Cisco Intersight API Request atomic exposes no supported conditional-header input, so the metadata PATCH sends no If-Match; prior ModTime is diagnostic only and a GET/PATCH race remains. RenameRequest and Metadata PATCH are evidenced by CiscoDevNet SDK commit 0e8dfdb798aac11684966f0edbbd5e5ea3106dff, generated from OpenAPI 1.0.11-2026072720 and newer than the local February OpenAPI; live-tenant compatibility remains required.
